16. A race car is traveling on a straight track at a velocity of 80 meters per second when the brakes
are applied at time t = O seconds. From time t = 0 to the moment the race car stops, the
acceleration of the race car is given by a(t) = -6t2 -t meters per second per second. During
this time period, how far does the race car travel?
(A)188.229 m
(B) 198.766 m
(C) 260.042 m
(D) 267.089 m
